=== File: ./src/authService.ts ===
import {
  signInWithPopup,
  GoogleAuthProvider,
  onAuthStateChanged,
  User,
  signOut
} from 'firebase/auth';

import { auth, googleProvider } from './firebase';

let isSigningIn = false;
let cachedAccessToken: string | null = null;

// Google-only auth listener
export const initAuth = (
  onAuthSuccess?: (user: User, token: string) => void,
  onAuthFailure?: () => void
) => {
  return onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user: User | null) => {
    if (user) {
      // If we already have a cached token, use it
      if (cachedAccessToken && onAuthSuccess) {
        onAuthSuccess(user, cachedAccessToken);
        return;
      }

      // Try to refresh the token from the current user
      const token = await user.getIdToken();
      cachedAccessToken = token;

      if (onAuthSuccess) onAuthSuccess(user, token);
    } else {
      // No user signed in — Google login required
      cachedAccessToken = null;
      if (onAuthFailure) onAuthFailure();
    }
  });
};

export const googleSignIn = async (): Promise<{ user: User; accessToken: string } | null> => {
  try {
    isSigningIn = true;

    const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider);
    const credential = GoogleAuthProvider.credentialFromResult(result);

    if (!credential?.accessToken) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get access token from Firebase Auth');
    }

    cachedAccessToken = credential.accessToken;

    return { user: result.user, accessToken: cachedAccessToken };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    if (err instanceof Error) {
      console.error('Sign in error:', err.message);
    } else {
      console.error('Sign in error:', String(err));
    }
    return null;
  } finally {
    isSigningIn = false;
  }
};

export const getAccessToken = async (): Promise<string | null> => {
  return cachedAccessToken;
};

export const logout = async () => {
  await signOut(auth);
  cachedAccessToken = null;
};

=== File: ./src/storageService.ts ===
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from 'firebase/storage';

export async function uploadEquipmentImage(file: File): Promise<string> {
  const storage = getStorage();
  const uuid = typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID 
    ? crypto.randomUUID() 
    : Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
    
  const storageRef = ref(storage, `equipment/${uuid}`);
  await uploadBytes(storageRef, file);
  const downloadUrl = await getDownloadURL(storageRef);
  return downloadUrl;
}

=== File: ./src/equipmentService.ts ===
import { collection, doc, getDocs, getDoc, addDoc, updateDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from './firebase';
import { Equipment, EquipmentStatus } from './types';

// Your Firestore rules require tenant‑scoped collections.
// This MUST match: /tenants/{tenantId}/inventory
const TENANT_ID = 'plantflow-os';

export async function listEquipment(): Promise<Equipment[]> {
  const equipmentCol = collection(db, `tenants/${TENANT_ID}/inventory`);
  const equipmentSnapshot = await getDocs(equipmentCol);

  return equipmentSnapshot.docs.map(doc => ({
    machine_id: doc.id,
    ...doc.data()
  }) as Equipment);
}

export async function getEquipment(id: string): Promise<Equipment | null> {
  const equipmentDoc = doc(db, `tenants/${TENANT_ID}/inventory/${id}`);
  const equipmentSnapshot = await getDoc(equipmentDoc);

  if (!equipmentSnapshot.exists()) return null;

  return {
    machine_id: equipmentSnapshot.id,
    ...equipmentSnapshot.data()
  } as Equipment;
}

export async function addEquipment(payload: Omit<Equipment, 'machine_id'>): Promise<Equipment> {
  const equipmentCol = collection(db, `tenants/${TENANT_ID}/inventory`);
  const docRef = await addDoc(equipmentCol, payload);

  return {
    machine_id: docRef.id,
    ...payload
  } as Equipment;
}

export async function updateEquipmentStatus(id: string, availability_status: EquipmentStatus): Promise<void> {
  const equipmentDoc = doc(db, `tenants/${TENANT_ID}/inventory/${id}`);
  await updateDoc(equipmentDoc, { availability_status });
}

=== File: ./src/components/RoleSwitcher.tsx ===
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HardHat, Users, Terminal, X, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface LogMessage {
  type: 'log' | 'warn' | 'error';
  text: string;
  time: string;
}

export default function RoleSwitcher() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isOperator = location.pathname.startsWith('/operator');

  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<LogMessage[]>([]);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const logsEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const originalLog = console.log;
    const originalWarn = console.warn;
    const originalError = console.error;

    const addLog = (type: 'log' | 'warn' | 'error', args: any[]) => {
      const text = args.map(arg => typeof arg === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(arg) : String(arg)).join(' ');
      const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
      setLogs(prev => [...prev.slice(-99), { type, text, time }]); // Keep last 100 logs
    };

    console.log = (...args: any[]) => {
      originalLog.apply(console, args);
      addLog('log', args);
    };

    console.warn = (...args: any[]) => {
      originalWarn.apply(console, args);
      addLog('warn', args);
    };

    console.error = (...args: any[]) => {
      originalError.apply(console, args);
      addLog('error', args);
    };

    // Global uncaught error listener
    const handleGlobalError = (event: ErrorEvent) => {
      addLog('error', [`Uncaught Error: ${event.message} at ${event.filename}:${event.lineno}`]);
    };
    window.addEventListener('error', handleGlobalError);

    // Global promise rejection listener
    const handleUnhandledRejection = (event: PromiseRejectionEvent) => {
      addLog('error', [`Unhandled Rejection: ${event.reason}`]);
    };
    window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', handleUnhandledRejection);

    return () => {
      console.log = originalLog;
      console.warn = originalWarn;
      console.error = originalError;
      window.removeEventListener('error', handleGlobalError);
      window.removeEventListener('unhandledrejection', handleUnhandledRejection);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && logsEndRef.current) {
      logsEndRef.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }, [logs, isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  // Don't show the switcher on the landing page
  if (location.pathname === '/') {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex items-center gap-2">
        {/* Debug Console Toggle Button */}
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
          className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-3 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all active:scale-95 relative focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 outline-none"
          title="Toggle Debug Console Logs"
          aria-label="Toggle Debug Console Logs"
        >
          <Terminal className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" aria-hidden="true" />
          {logs.filter(l => l.type === 'error').length > 0 && (
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-red-500 text-white text-[9px] font-black rounded-full w-4.5 h-4.5 flex items-center justify-center animate-pulse">
              {logs.filter(l => l.type === 'error').length}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>

        {/* Role Switcher Button */}
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate(isOperator ? '/customer' : '/operator')}
          className="bg-white p-3 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors text-slate-700 active:scale-95 focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 outline-none"
          title={`Switch to ${isOperator ? 'Customer' : 'Operator'} View`}
          aria-label={isOperator ? "Switch to Customer View" : "Switch to Operator Console"}
        >
          {isOperator ? <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" aria-hidden="true" /> : <HardHat className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" aria-hidden="true" />}
          <span className="hidden sm:inline font-bold text-sm">
            {isOperator ? 'Customer View' : 'Operator Console'}
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Debug Console Overlay Drawer */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div 
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-labelledby="console-logs-title"
          className="fixed bottom-20 left-4 right-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto bg-slate-950/95 backdrop-blur border border-slate-800 text-slate-100 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl z-50 flex flex-col h-80 overflow-hidden font-mono animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-800 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Terminal className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 animate-pulse" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span id="console-logs-title" className="sr-only">System Console Logs</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 tracking-wider">SYSTEM CONSOLE LOGS</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <button 
                onClick={() => setLogs([])}
                className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 outline-none"
                title="Clear Logs"
                aria-label="Clear console logs"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 outline-none"
                aria-label="Close console logs"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Console Output */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 text-[11px] leading-relaxed space-y-2.5">
            {logs.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-slate-500 italic text-center pt-8">No warnings or errors logged. System is operating normally.</div>
            ) : (
              logs.map((log, index) => (
                <div 
                  key={index} 
                  className={`flex gap-2 border-b border-slate-900 pb-1.5 ${
                    log.type === 'error' ? 'text-red-400 bg-red-950/10' : 
                    log.type === 'warn' ? 'text-amber-400 bg-amber-950/10' : 
                    'text-emerald-400'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-slate-600 shrink-0 font-bold">[{log.time}]</span>
                  <span className="break-all whitespace-pre-wrap">{log.text}</span>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
            <div ref={logsEndRef} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const NavItem = ({ to, icon, label }: { to: string; icon: React.ReactNode; label: string }) => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const isActive = location.pathname === to || (to !== '/operator' && location.pathname.startsWith(to));
  
  return (

export default function OperatorRoutes() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = initAuth(
      (u) => { setUser(u); setLoading(false); },
      () => { setUser(null); setLoading(false); }
    );
    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50"><div className="animate-spin w-8 h-8 border-4 border-indigo-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full"></div></div>;
  }

  if (!user) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 p-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl shadow-xl max-w-sm w-full text-center">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
            <ClipboardList className="w-8 h-8" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-2">PlantFlow OS Console</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mb-8">Sign in to manage your fleet and hires.</p>
          <button 
            onClick={() => googleSignIn()}
            className="w-full bg-indigo-600 text-white font-medium px-4 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 active:bg-indigo-800 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
          >
            <LogIn className="w-5 h-5" />
            Sign in with Google
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route element={<OperatorLayout />}>
        <Route index element={<OperatorDashboard/>} />
        <Route path="hires" element={<HiresList />} />
        <Route path="scan" element={<OperatorScan />} />

        <Route path="fleet/add" element={<OperatorAddEquipment />} />
        <Route path="integration" element={<IntegrationPlayground />} />
      </Route>
    </Routes>
  );
}

=== File: ./src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx ===
import React, { ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, Home } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';

interface Props {
  children?: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component<Props, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('Uncaught error:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }

      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 text-center">
            <div className="bg-red-50 w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-red-500" />
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-2">Something went wrong</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-600 mb-6">
              {this.state.error?.message || "An unexpected error occurred in this component."}
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-3 justify-center">
              <button
                onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })}
                className="px-6 py-3 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors"
              >
                Try Again
              </button>
              <Link
                to="/"
                onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })}
                className="px-6 py-3 bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <Home className="w-5 h-5" />
                Go Home
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}


=== File: ./src/bookingService.ts ===
import { collection, doc, getDocs, getDoc, addDoc, updateDoc, query, where, orderBy } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from './firebase';
import { Booking, BookingStatus } from './types';

// Your Firestore rules require tenant‑scoped collections.
// This MUST match: /tenants/{tenantId}/bookings
const TENANT_ID = 'plantflow-os';

export async function listBookings(status?: BookingStatus): Promise<Booking[]> {
  const bookingsCol = collection(db, `tenants/${TENANT_ID}/bookings`);

  let q = query(bookingsCol, orderBy('timestamp_created', 'desc'));

  if (status) {
    q = query(
      bookingsCol,
      where('status', '==', status),
      orderBy('timestamp_created', 'desc')
    );
  }

  const bookingsSnapshot = await getDocs(q);

  return bookingsSnapshot.docs.map(doc => ({
    booking_id: doc.id,
    ...doc.data()
  }) as Booking);
}

export async function getBooking(id: string): Promise<Booking | null> {
  const bookingDoc = doc(db, `tenants/${TENANT_ID}/bookings/${id}`);
  const bookingSnapshot = await getDoc(bookingDoc);

  if (!bookingSnapshot.exists()) return null;

  return {
    booking_id: bookingSnapshot.id,
    ...bookingSnapshot.data()
  } as Booking;
}

export async function createBooking(payload: Omit<Booking, 'booking_id' | 'timestamp_created'>): Promise<Booking> {
  const bookingsCol = collection(db, `tenants/${TENANT_ID}/bookings`);

  const timestamp_created = new Date().toISOString();
  const bookingData = { ...payload, timestamp_created };

  const docRef = await addDoc(bookingsCol, bookingData);

  return {
    booking_id: docRef.id,
    ...bookingData
  } as Booking;
}

export async function updateBookingStatus(id: string, status: BookingStatus): Promise<void> {
  const bookingDoc = doc(db, `tenants/${TENANT_ID}/bookings/${id}`);
  await updateDoc(bookingDoc, { status });
}

=== File: ./src/hooks/useOAuthToken.ts ===
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { googleSignIn, initAuth, logout } from '../authService';
import { User } from 'firebase/auth';

export function useOAuthToken() {
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [needsAuth, setNeedsAuth] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = initAuth(
      (user, token) => {
        setUser(user);
        setToken(token);
        setNeedsAuth(false);
      },
      () => {
        setUser(null);
        setToken(null);
        setNeedsAuth(true);
      }
    );
    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  const requestToken = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await googleSignIn();
      if (result) {
        setToken(result.accessToken);
        setUser(result.user);
        setNeedsAuth(false);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Login failed');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleLogout = useCallback(async () => {
    await logout();
    setToken(null);
    setUser(null);
    setNeedsAuth(true);
  }, []);

  return { token, user, needsAuth, error, isLoading, requestToken, logout: handleLogout };
}

=== File: ./src/hooks/useDocumentTitle.ts ===
import { useEffect } from 'react';

/**
 * Custom hook to dynamically update document title for WCAG 2.4.2 page titling compliance.
 * @param title The title for the current view.
 */
export function useDocumentTitle(title: string) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const prevTitle = document.title;
    document.title = `${title} | PlantFlow OS`;
    return () => {
      document.title = prevTitle;
    };
  }, [title]);
}
